drafts.draft_en:
Hey @grok, I just inherited my grandmom's rowhome in Philly. It needs about $40K of work and I don't have $40K.

Choose ONE:

• Borrow the money, fix it, and rent it out
• Fix it slowly and sell it in a year
• Sell it as-is now and move on

Be brutally honest.
drafts.pattern: 'Hey @grok' + pick-ONE fork (103.0k copy, 25.4k new variant), localized to an inherited Philly rowhome. Matches the topic of the Nov 15 @workwithbar seller video. Asks for opinions and promises no returns or prices.
drafts.video_tip: Talking head on a Philly rowhome stoop, 10–12s. Read it like you're asking Grok out loud, three fingers up, one per option, each option on screen as written. Caption every word. End on 'Be brutally honest' and point at the camera. After replies come in, pin your own take as the first reply.

drafts.draft_en:
Hey @grok, you're 45, you live in Philly, and your rowhome is paid off.

Choose ONE to build generational wealth by 60:

• Keep living in it and stay debt-free
• Rent it out and buy a second home
• Sell it and put the cash in an index fund

Be brutally honest.
drafts.pattern: Same skeleton as c_erraaa's 45/$750K variant (25.4k in a day): new age, new asset, three concrete options, 'be brutally honest'. Philly homeowner framing, no numbers promised.
drafts.video_tip: 6–8s: slow push-in on a paid-off rowhome front door, the three options appear one at a time as big text, no voiceover. Or post as text only with one street photo.

drafts.draft_en: Will Philly rents ever stop going up? 😬
